result.title: MLIPS: Multi-Layer Indexer Pool Sharing
result.summary: Sparse attention limits the keys used by each query, but finding those keys can still require a full-prefix scan at every layer. We introduce \textbf{MLIPS (Multi-Layer Indexer Pool Sharing)}, a training-free method that shares candidate search while retaining each consumer's own scoring and selection. A producer publishes a top-$M$ pool larger than the attention budget $K$; subsequent layers select their own top-$K$ from that pool. Measurements across three sparse-attention model families show substantially higher coverage from broad pools than overlap between final selections. We implement layerwise sharing, persistent decode reuse, and a coarse producer in vLLM for DeepSeek-V4-Flash. Across four long-context suites, three consumer layers per producer give $1.14$--$1.40\times$ speedups and $14.8$--$27.4\%$ lower GPU energy, with observed accuracy changes of $-1.49$ to $+0.29$ percentage points in single runs. More extensive sharing exposes task-dependent quality losses. Sampled prefill traces also reveal recurring selected KV positions across query groups and layers. We characterize this shared working-set structure and use it to motivate Top-$G$, an exploratory bounded pool construction for prefill. Its deployment, task accuracy, and serving benefits remain open.

AI.brief_summary: 提出免训练的 MLIPS，让生产层发布 top-M 候选池、后续层在池内自行打分选 top-K，以共享稀疏注意力的索引搜索，并在 vLLM 上实现层间共享、解码复用和粗粒度生产层。
AI.relevance_reason: 其跨层共享候选、各层独立打分的机制可能为 VLM 多层视觉证据筛选及 KV/状态复用提供借鉴；但论文面向长上下文稀疏注意力加速，未涉及多模态推理或 latent 状态，需核查共享粒度与质量损失。
